title: Topology struct field comment still declares the catalog default preset as the draw-time pipe default
evidence: pipe_weights: [dynamic][3]i32,  // per-pipe lane WFQ weights (parallel to pipes); default = the catalog default preset at draw
detail: apply_draw (same file, line 199) now appends qos_unconfigured_weights(cat), but the field's own comment still documents the retired balanced-preset default — the same 'drift documented as canon' class this PR fixes in balance.json.
recommended_fix: Update the trailing comment to 'default = the unconfigured 100% Standard set at draw (qos_unconfigured_weights, 08-19 ruling)'.

title: serialize.odin sparse-contract comments still reference the catalog default preset
evidence:
// they differ from the catalog default preset — 3.2).
	// Only pipes whose weights differ from the catalog default preset serialize
detail: Lines 66 and 332 describe def_w as the catalog default preset, but line 348 sets def_w := qos_unconfigured_weights(cat). The new 08-19 comment at 343-347 was added while the two older statements were left stale.
recommended_fix: Reword both comments to 'differ from the unconfigured default (qos_unconfigured_weights)'.

title: qos_allocate E5 inline comment still says 'the catalog default preset'
evidence: weights = default_w // E5 — the catalog default preset
detail: The doc block above was updated to 'the caller's default (qos_pipe_caps passes the unconfigured 100% Standard set)', but this inline comment on the assignment itself was missed; default_w is no longer the catalog default preset at any call site.
recommended_fix: Change the inline comment to '// E5 — the caller's default (the unconfigured 100% Standard set from qos_pipe_caps)'.

title: wire_test_catalog comment claims preset-based draw default and omits auto_ladder, yielding {0,0,0} pipe weights
detail: The comment is stale (apply_draw now reads auto_ladder via qos_unconfigured_weights), and this catalog never sets auto_ladder, so pipes drawn in wire_setup get weights {0,0,0}. Inert today — wire tests never step flow or read caps (verified by grep) — but a trap for any future render test that touches lane_caps.
recommended_fix: Set cat.balance.auto_ladder = {{100,0,0},{70,30,0},{50,30,20}} to mirror core's test_catalog and fix the comment.

title: core test_catalog comment still says balanced is the default every pipe starts on
evidence:
// 3.2: the emphasis-dial presets (mirrors data/balance.json) — balanced is
	// the default every pipe starts on + the E5 all-zero fallback.
detail: Stale: no pipe starts on balanced anymore (the 08-19 unconfigured default is auto_ladder[0][0] on Standard, set just below at lines 102-106). Comment-only drift in the shared test fixture every core test builds on.
recommended_fix: Reword to 'balanced remains an app-side quick-set preset; pipes start on the 08-19 unconfigured 100% Standard default'.

title: default_preset_idx / default_lane_preset is now write-only: load-validated but consumed by no production code
detail: After this PR the four former readers (apply_draw, qos_pipe_weights, qos_pipe_caps, serialize def_w) all use qos_unconfigured_weights. Verified by grep: the only remaining references are the catalog loader/validator and test catalogs — the app panel iterates lane_presets directly. balance.json still hard-requires a field nothing reads.
recommended_fix: Either wire default_preset_idx as the QoS panel's highlighted quick-set, or drop the required default_lane_preset field and its validation in a follow-up.
